title: The verb 'to be'
summaryAr: في العربية نقول «أنا طالب» بدون فعل، لكن الإنجليزية تحتاج دائماً فعل be.

sections.bodyAr: نستخدم am مع I، وis مع he/she/it، وare مع you/we/they.
للنفي نضيف not بعد الفعل. وللسؤال نقدّم الفعل على الفاعل.

arabicTip: لا تحذف الفعل! الخطأ الشائع: «She very happy» والصحيح: She is very happy.

exercises.prompt: She ___ my sister.
We ___ from Jordan.
I ___ a teacher.
___ they at school? (question)
Put the words in the correct order.
exercises.explanationAr: الترتيب: الفاعل + is + الوصف. ولاحظ an قبل engineer لأنها تبدأ بصوت متحرك.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is correct?
exercises.explanationAr: لا يمكن حذف is في الإنجليزية.

title: Present simple

sections.bodyAr: نستخدم الفعل كما هو، ونضيف s أو es مع he/she/it.
نستخدم do/does. ومع does يعود الفعل لأصله بدون s.

arabicTip: لا تنسَ s مع he/she/it: «He go» خطأ، والصحيح He goes.

exercises.prompt: My brother ___ football every Friday.
___ you like pizza?
She ___ (not / like) spicy food.
exercises.explanationAr: مع she: doesn't + الفعل بدون s.

exercises.prompt: He ___ (watch) TV in the evening.
exercises.explanationAr: الأفعال المنتهية بـ ch نضيف لها es.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order.
exercises.explanationAr: السؤال: كلمة الاستفهام + do + الفاعل + الفعل.

title: Articles: a, an, the
summaryAr: من أصعب النقاط على العرب: متى نستخدم a/an، ومتى the، ومتى لا شيء.

sections.bodyAr: مع الاسم المفرد المعدود عند ذكره لأول مرة أو لوصف المهنة. an قبل الصوت المتحرك.
عندما يكون الشيء معروفاً أو مذكوراً سابقاً أو فريداً.
examples: I bought a book. The book is great.

sections.bodyAr: مع الجمع والأشياء غير المعدودة عند التعميم.

arabicTip: في العربية نقول «الحياة جميلة» مع «ال»، لكن بالإنجليزية: Life is beautiful (بدون the) لأننا نتكلم بشكل عام.

exercises.prompt: He is ___ honest man.
exercises.explanationAr: honest تبدأ بصوت متحرك لأن h صامتة.

exercises.prompt: I love ___ music.
exercises.explanationAr: عند الحديث عن الموسيقى بشكل عام لا نستخدم أداة.

exercises.prompt: Can you open ___ window?
My sister is ___ doctor.
___ moon is beautiful tonight.

title: Past simple
summaryAr: لأحداث انتهت في وقت محدّد في الماضي.

sections.bodyAr: نضيف ed للأفعال المنتظمة، والشاذة لها صيغ خاصة يجب حفظها.
examples: We went to the beach last summer.

sections.bodyAr: نستخدم did، ويعود الفعل لأصله.

arabicTip: بعد did يأتي الفعل في أصله: «Did you went» خطأ، والصحيح Did you go.

exercises.prompt: We ___ a great film last night.
Did she ___ the email?
They ___ (travel) to Turkey in 2022.
I ___ (not / go) to work yesterday.
Put the words in the correct order.
exercises.answer: What time did you wake up
exercises.explanationAr: السؤال بالماضي: كلمة الاستفهام + did + الفاعل + الفعل.

title: Present continuous vs present simple
summaryAr: المستمر لما يحدث الآن أو مؤقتاً، والبسيط للعادات والحقائق.

sections.bodyAr: am/is/are + فعل ing لشيء يحدث الآن أو هذه الفترة أو خطة قريبة.
examples: I'm reading a great book these days.

sections.bodyAr: أفعال مثل know, like, want, need لا تأتي عادة بصيغة ing.

arabicTip: خطأ شائع: «I am knowing him» والصحيح I know him.

exercises.prompt: Be quiet! The baby ___.
I usually ___ to work by bus.
I ___ what you mean.
What ___ you ___ now? (do)
Put the words in the correct order.
exercises.answer: She is studying for her exams this week

title: Comparatives and superlatives
summaryAr: للمقارنة بين شيئين أو اختيار الأفضل بين مجموعة.

sections.bodyAr: صفة قصيرة + er + than، أو more + صفة طويلة + than.
examples: This book is more interesting than that one.
My car is older than yours.

sections.bodyAr: the + صفة + est، أو the most + صفة طويلة. وهناك صيغ شاذة: good-better-best.
examples: It's the tallest building in the city.
She is the most intelligent student.
This is the best day of my life.

arabicTip: لا تجمع بين الطريقتين: «more bigger» خطأ، والصحيح bigger.

exercises.prompt: Today is ___ than yesterday.
This is the ___ restaurant in town.
exercises.explanationAr: التفضيل من good هو the best.

exercises.prompt: English is ___ (easy) than Chinese.
It was the ___ (expensive) hotel we stayed in.
Put the words in the correct order.
exercises.answer: My brother is taller than me

title: Present perfect vs past simple
summaryAr: لا يوجد زمن مقابل له في العربية، لذا يحتاج تركيزاً خاصاً.

sections.bodyAr: have/has + التصريف الثالث: لتجربة حياة بدون وقت محدد، أو شيء بدأ ومستمر، أو نتيجة تهمّنا الآن.
عندما نذكر وقتاً محدداً انتهى.
examples: She moved here five years ago.

sections.bodyAr: since مع نقطة البداية، وfor مع المدة.
examples: for three hours / for ten years

arabicTip: لا نستخدم المضارع التام مع وقت ماضٍ محدد: «I have seen him yesterday» خطأ، والصحيح I saw him yesterday.

exercises.prompt: I ___ this film three times.
We ___ to Paris last year.
exercises.explanationAr: last year وقت محدد → ماضٍ بسيط.

exercises.prompt: He has worked here ___ 2018.
___ you ever ___ sushi? (eat)
She has been a teacher ___ ten years.
Put the words in the correct order.
exercises.answer: I have never been to Japan
exercises.explanationAr: never تأتي بين have والتصريف الثالث.

title: Future: will vs going to

sections.bodyAr: لقرار لحظي، أو وعد، أو توقّع مبني على رأي.
examples: I think it will rain tomorrow.

sections.bodyAr: لخطة مقرّرة مسبقاً، أو توقّع مبني على دليل نراه.
examples: We're going to buy a house next year.
Look at those clouds! It's going to rain.

arabicTip: بعد will يأتي الفعل الأصلي بدون to: «I will to go» خطأ.

exercises.prompt: The phone is ringing. — I ___ answer it.
I've already decided. I ___ study medicine.
Be careful! You ___ fall!
Don't worry, I ___ tell anyone. (promise, negative)
Put the words in the correct order.
exercises.answer: What are you going to do this weekend
exercises.explanationAr: سؤال عن خطة: be going to.

title: First and second conditional
summaryAr: الأولى لاحتمال حقيقي في المستقبل، والثانية لموقف خيالي أو غير مرجّح.

sections.bodyAr: If + مضارع بسيط، will + فعل.
examples: If it rains, we'll stay at home.

sections.bodyAr: If + ماضٍ بسيط، would + فعل.
examples: If I had more money, I would travel the world.
If I were you, I would accept the offer.

arabicTip: لا نستخدم will بعد if: «If it will rain» خطأ، والصحيح If it rains.

exercises.prompt: If you heat ice, it ___.
If I ___ rich, I would buy an island.
If she calls, I ___ (tell) her the news.
What ___ you do if you lost your phone?
Put the words in the correct order.
exercises.answer: If I were you I would talk to him

title: The passive voice
summaryAr: عندما يكون الفعل أهمّ من الفاعل، أو الفاعل غير معروف.

sections.bodyAr: be (بالزمن المناسب) + التصريف الثالث.
examples: English is spoken all over the world.
The results will be announced tomorrow.

sections.bodyAr: نذكر الفاعل بـ by عند الحاجة فقط.
examples: The novel was written by Naguib Mahfouz.

arabicTip: لا تنسَ فعل be: «The house built in 1980» خطأ، والصحيح The house was built in 1980.

exercises.prompt: This museum ___ every year by millions of people.
The letters ___ yesterday.
The new hospital ___ (open) next month.
My phone has ___ (repair).
Put the words in the correct order.
exercises.answer: The meeting was cancelled because of the storm

title: Reported speech
summaryAr: لنقل ما قاله شخص آخر، غالباً بإرجاع الزمن خطوة للخلف.

sections.bodyAr: المضارع → ماضٍ، الماضي → ماضٍ تام، will → would.
examples: "I'm tired." → She said (that) she was tired.
"I will help." → He said he would help.

sections.bodyAr: نستخدم ترتيب الجملة الخبرية، ومع أسئلة yes/no نستخدم if أو whether.
examples: She asked me where I lived.
He asked if I was ready.

arabicTip: في السؤال المنقول لا نقلب الترتيب: «She asked where did I live» خطأ.

exercises.prompt: "I love this city." → He said he ___ the city.
She asked me ___.
"I will call you." → He promised he ___ call me.
"Are you hungry?" → She asked ___ I was hungry.
Put the words in the correct order.
exercises.answer: He told me that he had finished the report

title: Relative clauses
summaryAr: لربط المعلومات باستخدام who, which, that, whose, where.

sections.bodyAr: who للأشخاص، which للأشياء، that للاثنين، whose للملكية، where للمكان.
examples: The man who called you is my uncle.
The book which I bought is excellent.
That's the woman whose son is a pilot.
This is the café where we met.

sections.bodyAr: لا نكرّر الضمير بعد اسم الموصول كما نفعل بالعربية.
examples: The car that I bought is red. (not: that I bought it)

arabicTip: بالعربية نقول «السيارة التي اشتريتها»، لكن بالإنجليزية لا نضيف it: The car that I bought.

exercises.prompt: The student ___ won the prize is from Egypt.
I know a girl ___ father is a famous singer.
Which sentence is correct?
options: The phone that I bought it is broken.
The phone that I bought is broken.
exercises.answer: The phone that I bought is broken.

exercises.prompt: That's the hotel ___ we stayed last summer.
Put the words in the correct order.
exercises.answer: The film which we watched was amazing

title: Inversion for emphasis
summaryAr: أسلوب رسمي قوي يُستخدم في الكتابة والخطابة وامتحان IELTS.

sections.bodyAr: عند بدء الجملة بـ Never, Rarely, Not only, Hardly نقلب الفاعل والفعل المساعد.
examples: Never have I seen such a beautiful view.
Not only did she win, but she also broke the record.
Rarely do we get such an opportunity.

sections.bodyAr: Only after, Only when, No sooner… than.
examples: Only after the meeting did I understand the problem.
No sooner had we arrived than it started to rain.

arabicTip: استخدم القلب باعتدال؛ فهو رسمي وقد يبدو غريباً في الحديث اليومي.

exercises.prompt: Never ___ such a delicious meal.
Not only ___ late, but he also forgot the tickets.
Rarely ___ he complain about anything. (present)
No sooner had I sat down ___ the phone rang.
Put the words in the correct order.
exercises.answer: Only then did I realise my mistake

title: Third and mixed conditionals
summaryAr: للحديث عن الماضي الذي لم يحدث ونتائجه.

sections.bodyAr: If + ماضٍ تام، would have + التصريف الثالث (ماضٍ لم يحدث).
examples: If I had studied harder, I would have passed.
If we had left earlier, we wouldn't have missed the train.

sections.bodyAr: شرط في الماضي ونتيجة في الحاضر، أو العكس.
examples: If I had taken that job, I would be rich now.
If she weren't so shy, she would have spoken at the meeting.

arabicTip: خطأ شائع: «If I would have known» والصحيح If I had known.

exercises.prompt: If they ___ the map, they wouldn't have got lost.
If I had saved money, I ___ a car now.
exercises.explanationAr: شرط ماضٍ ونتيجة حاضرة: would have (يمتلك الآن).

exercises.prompt: If you had told me, I ___ helped you.
Put the words in the correct order.
exercises.answer: If I had known I would have come
